meta.title: A PR-created event's line item cannot be deleted below one
gaps: PR-created event setup is represented by awarded_rfq recipe which provides a live published event with one line item

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event the QA vendor bid on, closed, and awarded to that vendor (award submitted for approval).
steps: The buyer sends the request that updates (and publishes) the event, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
As the buyer, read the event and check that the event is still active (nothing changed).
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You cannot delete this line item from the project”, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: the event is still active (nothing changed).

plan.title: A PR-created event's line item cannot be deleted below one

assert.say: the event is still active (nothing changed)

expected.message: You cannot delete this line item from the project
